RESOLVED: Dear Dana Whitfield,

Thank you for reaching out regarding the denial of your MRI claim (CLM-550193). 

"Prior authorization not on file" means that the specific procedure required approval from Meridian Health Plan before it was performed. Because this was not obtained, the claim was denied.

You do have the right to appeal this decision. According to our policy, you have 180 days from the date of your denial notice to file a first-level appeal. I recommend that you contact your doctor, Dr. L. Okonjo, to request that they submit a retrospective authorization request along with the clinical documentation supporting the medical necessity of your MRI. 

You can also file a formal appeal using form FORM-APP-1. Once an appeal is submitted, we typically reach a decision within 30 calendar days. 

Please let us know if you need any further assistance. This ticket is now resolved.
